Tracking.title: Track Your Order
Tracking.subtitle: To track your order, enter your Order ID and the billing email used at checkout. Your Order ID was shown on your receipt and in your confirmation email.
Tracking.invalidInput: Please provide a valid Order ID and email address.
Tracking.notFound: No order matches this Order ID and email combination. Please check your confirmation email, or contact us for help.
Tracking.requestFailed: We could not reach the order service. Please try again in a moment.
Tracking.statusPlaced: Your order has been received and is awaiting payment confirmation.
Tracking.statusPayment: Payment confirmed. Your order is now being prepared by the atelier.
Tracking.statusShipped: Your order is on its way to you.
Tracking.statusDelivered: Delivered. We hope you love it.
Tracking.cancelledNote: This order was cancelled. If you were not expecting this, please contact us.
Tracking.refundedNote: This payment was refunded. Your bank typically reflects it within a few working days.
